correctness.rationale: Geodesics in K_3 square K_n have exactly two length-2 alternatives for diagonal pairs; C4 obstruction is exact. Every column support is a subset of [3], and pair supports are unique. The no-triple versus one-triple count gives all coefficients. Maximal sets require all columns nonempty, and respectively exactly one triple, exactly two distinct pairs with all other singleton rows forced to their intersection, or all three pair supports and arbitrary remaining singletons. All directions and n=2 boundary are proved in RESULT.md. Independently constructed graph tests exhaust 299584 literal subsets for n=2 through 6, verifying all coefficients, maximality and types; infinite n rests on proof.
